exposure: monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies with selective intrauterine growth restriction (sIUGR)
singleton pregnancies with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR)
cohort: Newborns from 67 monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies complicated with sIUGR and 184 newborns from singleton pregnancies with IUGR, managed at a single tertiary care hospital.
finding: Neonates from MCDA pregnancies complicated with sIUGR and those from singleton pregnancies with IUGR showed no significant difference in neonatal morbidity, mortality, or the composite morbidity-mortality endpoint.
birth_weight: Measured, and found comparable between groups (p > 0.05), but no specific values or range provided.
gest_age: Measured, and found comparable between groups (p > 0.05), but no specific values or range provided.
